lesson_title: LESSON 07: Sharing the Road & Special Circumstances
prompt: What physical sensory characteristics make carbon monoxide (CO) gas exceptionally dangerous?

options.text: It is completely colorless, odorless, and tasteless, making it undetectable without sensors
It smells intensely of rotten sulfur eggs, causing instant sneezing reactions
It displays a thick neon yellow cloud that obscures vehicle windshield glass
It burns driver throat tissues instantly upon entering passenger vehicle cabins
